hard:totem-nexus:totem-core.feature: TotemNexus consumes the Core Friendship API for friend relationships and player targets.
hard:totem-nexus:totem-core.auditNote: NexusFriendSavedData and NexusFriendshipApi delegate friendship state and mutual-friend checks to TotemFriendshipApi.

hard:totem-locksmith:totem-core.feature: TotemLocksmith access control consumes the Core Friendship API for friendship-based authorization.
hard:totem-locksmith:totem-core.auditNote: LocksmithAccessService uses TotemFriendshipApi as the server-authoritative friendship source for access decisions.

automata-excavation.auditNote: Copper Golem gathering recognizes Excavation hammer identity and selected-area excavation; combat positioning is unrelated.

villagers-remnant.auditNote: Toolsmith work orders, workshop completion, merchant offers, and pricing participate in four-tier Remnant backpack production and sales.

remnant-trinkets.feature: Fabric suggests Trinkets Updated >=4.1.0-beta.2; active production bridge not independently verified in this audit.
remnant-trinkets.auditNote: Keep this relationship at module level until current production source evidence for the Trinkets inventory/death bridge is restored.

vanilla-nexus-observer.auditNote: Generic Nexus Observer covers compass/map/management, legacy map, friends, and registration. Death-node admin remains a separate provider.

vanilla-remnant-observer.auditNote: The current curated feature vocabulary has no standalone Remnant backpack GUI/Observer feature; the inventory sidebar remains the closest UI-owned endpoint.

automata-openai.auditNote: LLM rules participate in both sorting/classification and gathering decisions.

event-remnant-death.auditNote: Core defines the Remnant death-backpack lifecycle contract; the current Remnant publisher call was not independently located during this audit.

event-nexus-audit.auditNote: Nexus publishes both public Space Unit updates and death/admin audit events.
